expectations.text: States the new prohibited-practice items added by the Digital Omnibus apply from December 2, 2026
expectations.evidence: "a new prohibition on AI systems generating non-consensual sexual or intimate imagery... and child sexual abuse material, which I believe applies from 2 December 2026"

expectations.text: States GPAI models placed on the market before August 2, 2026 must comply with Article 50(2) machine-readable marking by December 2, 2026
expectations.evidence: "the grace period for the Art. 50(2) obligation to mark synthetic audio, image, video and text in machine-readable form, for systems placed on the market before 2 August 2026... shortened it to 2 December 2026"

expectations.text: Identifies the Digital Omnibus as Regulation (EU) 2026/1744, in force July 27, 2026
expectations.evidence: Never cites Regulation (EU) 2026/1744 or its July 27, 2026 entry into force; says "Confirm the Omnibus has been published in the Official Journal and in force".

expectations.text: Distinguishes these December 2026 items from the shifted high-risk dates (December 2, 2027 and August 2, 2028)
expectations.evidence: "High-risk obligations did NOT land in December 2026: Annex III obligations were postponed to about 2 December 2027, and Annex I product-related ones to about 2 August 2028."

expectations.text: Gives practical steps for marking compliance (machine-readable disclosure of AI-generated content)
expectations.evidence: "confirm machine-readable marking (watermark/metadata, detectable) is deployed for all systems, including legacy ones"
